title.en: Relate amplitude, frequency, period and angular frequency

say.en: The supply at home changes direction 100 times every second. It follows a smooth sine curve because it comes from a coil turning in a magnetic field. In this lesson: Distinguish AC from DC.
Relate amplitude, frequency, period and angular frequency.
Describe phase and phase difference.

body.en: An *alternating* voltage changes in size and reverses direction periodically: $v = V_m \sin ωt$. $V_m$ is the peak value (amplitude), f is the frequency in hertz, $T = 1/f$ is the time period and $ω = 2πf$ is the angular frequency in rad/s. Indian mains is 230 V, 50 Hz, so T = 20 ms.
body.kn: ಪರ್ಯಾಯ ವಿಭವಾಂತರ ನಿಯತವಾಗಿ ಗಾತ್ರ ಬದಲಿಸಿ ದಿಕ್ಕನ್ನು ತಿರುಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ: v = Vm sin ωt. Vm ಶಿಖರ ಮೌಲ್ಯ, f ಆವೃತ್ತಿ, T = 1/f ಆವರ್ತ ಕಾಲ, ω = 2πf ಕೋನೀಯ ಆವೃತ್ತಿ. ಭಾರತದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸರಬರಾಜು 230 V, 50 Hz.

say.en: omega equals 2 pi f.
Indian mains: 50 hertz, T equals 20 milliseconds.

title.en: On the board: The sine wave

say.en: An AC voltage rises, falls and reverses again and again. Its graph is a sine wave.
The highest point is the peak value, Vm. For our mains it is 325 volts.
One full cycle takes the time period T. At 50 hertz, T is one-fiftieth of a second, 20 milliseconds.
A second wave of the same frequency, shifted earlier by 60 degrees, is said to lead the first by 60 degrees.
So if you are given v = 325 sin 314t, read off Vm = 325 V, omega = 314, and f = 50 hertz.
On the board: The sine wave.

title.en: A rotating phasor makes a sine wave

narration.en: The arrow (phasor) turns at ω = 2πf. Its height at each instant is the voltage v = Vm sin ωt, traced on the graph. Turn on the second wave and shift its phase to see lead and lag.
narration.kn: ಬಾಣ (ಫೇಸರ್) ω = 2πf ವೇಗದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರುಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ಕ್ಷಣದ ಅದರ ಎತ್ತರವೇ v = Vm sin ωt. ಎರಡನೇ ತರಂಗದ ಹಂತ ಬದಲಿಸಿ ಮುನ್ನಡೆ ಮತ್ತು ಹಿನ್ನಡೆ ನೋಡಿ.

body.en: *Phase* tells where in its cycle a wave is at a given instant. Two waves of the same frequency may be shifted: $v_1 = V_m \sin ωt$ and $v_2 = V_m \sin(ωt + φ)$. If φ is positive, $v_2$ leads $v_1$ by φ; if negative, it lags. Waves with φ = 0 are in phase.
body.kn: ಹಂತ ಎಂದರೆ ಒಂದು ಕ್ಷಣದಲ್ಲಿ ತರಂಗವು ತನ್ನ ಆವರ್ತದ ಯಾವ ಭಾಗದಲ್ಲಿದೆ ಎಂಬುದು. ಒಂದೇ ಆವೃತ್ತಿಯ ಎರಡು ತರಂಗಗಳ ನಡುವೆ φ ಹಂತ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಇರಬಹುದು; φ ಧನವಾದರೆ ಮುನ್ನಡೆ, ಋಣವಾದರೆ ಹಿಂದುಳಿಕೆ.

say.en: Phase tells where in its cycle a wave is at a given instant. Two waves of the same frequency may be shifted: v1 equals Vm sin omega t and v2 equals Vm sinomega t plus phi. If phi is positive, v2 leads v1 by phi; if negative, it lags. Waves with phi equals 0 are in phase. phi > 0: leads; phi < 0: lags.

problem.en: For v = 325 sin 314t volts, find the peak value, frequency and time period.

steps.en: Comparing with v = V_m sin ωt: V_m = 325 V and ω = 314 rad/s.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. For v = 325 sin 314t volts, find the peak value, frequency and time period.

say.en: Let us solve this together. For v equals 325 sin 314t volts, find the peak value, frequency and time period.
Comparing with v equals V m sin omega t: V m equals 325 volts and omega equals 314 rad/s.
f equals omega /2 pi equals 314 over 6.283 is approximately 50 hertz.
T equals 1 over f equals 1 over 50 equals 0.02 seconds equals 20 milliseconds.
So the answer is 325 volts, 50 hertz, 20 milliseconds.

problem.en: A 50 Hz voltage has a peak of 100 V. Find its instantaneous value 2.5 ms after it passes through zero going positive.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A 50 Hz voltage has a peak of 100 V. Find its instantaneous value 2.5 ms after it passes through zero going positive.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A 50 hertz voltage has a peak of 100 volts. Find its instantaneous value 2.5 milliseconds after it passes through zero going positive.
omega t equals 2 pi times 50 times 0.0025 equals pi /4 rad 45 degrees.
v equals 100 sin 45 degrees equals 100 times 0.707 equals 70.7 volts.
So the answer is 70.7 volts.

points.kn: v = Vm sin ωt, ω = 2πf, T = 1/f.

points.en: Indian mains: 230 V rms, 50 Hz, period 20 ms.
points.kn: ಭಾರತದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸರಬರಾಜು: 230 V, 50 Hz, ಆವರ್ತ ಕಾಲ 20 ms.

points.en: A positive phase angle means the wave leads.
points.kn: ಧನ ಹಂತ ಕೋನ ಎಂದರೆ ತರಂಗ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

homework.en: For i = 5 sin(1000πt + π/6) A, find the peak current, frequency and phase angle.

narration.en: Recap. v = V_m sin ωt with ω = 2πf and T = 1/f. Indian mains: 230 V rms, 50 Hz, period 20 ms. A positive phase angle means the wave leads.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. v = Vm sin ωt, ω = 2πf, T = 1/f. ಭಾರತದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸರಬರಾಜು: 230 V, 50 Hz, ಆವರ್ತ ಕಾಲ 20 ms. ಧನ ಹಂತ ಕೋನ ಎಂದರೆ ತರಂಗ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Let us recall the key ideas. v equals V m sin omega t with omega equals 2 pi f and T equals 1 over f.
say.kn: ಮುಖ್ಯ ಅಂಶಗಳನ್ನು ನೆನಪಿಸಿಕೊಳ್ಳೋಣ. v equals Vm sin omega t, omega equals 2 pi f, T equals 1 over f.

say.en: Indian mains: 230 volts rms, 50 hertz, period 20 milliseconds.
say.kn: ಭಾರತದ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಸರಬರಾಜು: 230 volts, 50 hertz, ಆವರ್ತ ಕಾಲ 20 milliseconds.

say.en: A positive phase angle means the wave leads.
say.kn: ಧನ ಹಂತ ಕೋನ ಎಂದರೆ ತರಂಗ ಮುನ್ನಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Next: Peak, average and RMS values.
say.kn: ಮುಂದೆ: ಶಿಖರ, ಸರಾಸರಿ ಮತ್ತು RMS ಮೌಲ್ಯಗಳು.
